clean_description: This book examines why many Americans are abandoning traditional banks and turning to alternative financial services. Lisa Servon shares insights from her experiences working in check-cashing and payday lending businesses, highlighting the struggles of lower- and middle-income individuals with the banking system. The book also explores innovative financial solutions emerging to address the needs of underserved communities.
themes: economic inequality, banking alternatives, financial justice
setting: contemporary America, focusing on urban financial systems
